enriched_activities.desc: Lying in bed. Eyes closed. Breathing slowly. Turns to left side. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Turns to right side. Sleeps. Wakes briefly. Turns over. Adjusts pillow again. Sleeps. Moves arm. Moves leg. Turns to back. Sleeps.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Removes clothes. Steps into shower. Wets body. Applies soap. Scrubs body. Rinses body. Turns off water. Steps out of shower. Picks up towel. Dries body. Dries hair. Wraps towel around body. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out eggs and milk. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out plate and pan. Places pan on stove. Turns on stove. Cracks eggs into pan. Cooks eggs. Toasts bread. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats breakfast. Places plate in sink. Washes dishes. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Getting dressed and preparing for the workday
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to bedroom. Opens closet. Selects shirt. Selects pants. Removes sleepwear. Puts on shirt. Puts on pants. Puts on socks. Puts on shoes. Stands in front of mirror. Adjusts shirt. Combs hair. Picks up phone. Checks phone. Picks up bag. Packs laptop. Walks out of bedroom.

enriched_activities.activity: Reviewing work schedule and setting up workspace
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Turns on desk lamp. Opens laptop. Presses power button. Enters password. Opens calendar app. Reviews schedule. Writes notes in planner. Picks up phone. Checks messages. Puts down phone. Adjusts chair. Opens notebook. Writes tasks. Closes notebook. Opens email. Reads emails. Replies to emails. Organizes desk items. Plugs in laptop charger.

enriched_activities.activity: Working on community program coordination tasks
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Types report. Saves document. Opens spreadsheet. Enters data. Makes phone call. Speaks on phone. Hangs up. Sends email. Attends video meeting. Turns on camera. Speaks in meeting. Takes notes. Ends meeting. Reviews tasks. Updates calendar. Stands up. Stretches. Sits down.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out sandwich ingredients. Closes refrigerator. Places items on counter. Opens cupboard. Takes out plate. Takes out knife from drawer. Spreads mayonnaise on bread. Places lettuce on bread. Places cheese on bread. Closes sandwich. Places sandwich on plate. Sits at table. Eats sandwich. Drinks water. Places plate in sink. Washes dishes. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Continuing work on community program coordination
enriched_activities.desc: Sits at desk. Opens laptop. Checks email. Replies to emails. Opens document. Edits report. Saves document. Makes phone call. Discusses project. Hangs up. Opens spreadsheet. Analyzes data. Creates chart. Saves spreadsheet. Attends virtual meeting. Shares screen. Takes notes. Ends meeting. Reviews progress. Updates task list. Stands up.

Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Changes channels. Watches show. Adjusts volume. Puts down remote. Picks up phone. Checks social media. Puts down phone. Picks up remote. Changes channel again. Watches another show. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to kitchen. Turns on light. Opens refrigerator. Takes out vegetables and chicken. Closes refrigerator. Opens cupboard. Takes out pot and pan. Places pot on stove. Turns on stove. Adds water to pot. Cuts vegetables. Adds vegetables to pot. Cooks chicken in pan. Turns off stove. Places food on plate. Sits at table. Eats dinner. Places plate in sink. Washes dishes. Walks out of kitchen.

enriched_activities.activity: Leisure activities: watching TV, reading, listening to music
enriched_activities.desc: Walks to living room. Sits on couch. Picks up remote. Turns on TV. Watches show. Picks up book. Opens book. Reads pages. Turns page. Puts down book. Picks up phone. Opens music app. Plays music. Listens to music. Puts down phone. Picks up remote. Changes channel. Watches another show. Turns off TV. Stands up.

Walks to bathroom. Turns on light. Turns on water heater. Adjusts water temperature. Washes face. Applies cleanser. Rinses face. Dries face with towel. Picks up toothbrush. Squeezes toothpaste onto toothbrush. Brushes teeth. Rinses mouth. Spits into sink. Puts down toothbrush. Turns off water. Turns off light. Walks out of bathroom.

Walks to bedroom. Closes door. Turns off main light. Walks to bed. Pulls back blanket. Sits on bed. Lies down. Pulls blanket up. Adjusts pillow. Closes eyes. Breathes slowly. Turns to left side. Adjusts blanket. Turns to right side. Sleeps.
